Torchyn Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Volyn Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. According to Pinkasei Kehilot Polin, a grave for victims of the Khmelnytsky uprising of 1648–49 once stood on this cemetery's site, though it remains unknown whether this refers to the same cemetery or a different one dating from at least the 17th century. This cemetery itself existed from at least the late 18th century, based on its oldest tombstone. In 1960, a memorial was constructed for the 2,000 Jews shot here in August 1942, alongside an obelisk and a fenced mass grave.
